meta.title: Mean Temperature each Day in July— Central England
meta.subtitle: Second-warmest July in 255 years (monthly mean 19.5°C; 2006 led at 19.8°C)
meta.summary: Each dot is one day in July across the full HadCET daily-mean series (Central England). The trend line summarizes the century-scale pattern. July 2026 ranked second-warmest by monthly mean — explore hover and click below.
meta.captionPlain: Source: Met Office HadCET. Graphic: David Curran
meta.pageSummary: After a record-breaking June, July 2026 did not rewrite daily HadCET England extremes — but as a whole month it ranked second-warmest since 1772, behind only 2006. Three interactive charts place every July day against the full Central England series. Click around on them and see how temperatures have differed over time.
